text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Command the Israelites to put out of the camp everyone who is leprous, or has a discharge, and everyone who is unclean through contact with a corpse;
text_cn: “你命以色列子民把患任何癞病、任何淋病及所有为死尸沾染不洁的人送出营外，

text_en: you shall put out both male and female, putting them outside the camp; they must not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.
text_cn: 不论男女，都应送到营外去，免得我住在他们中的营幕沾染不洁。”

text_en: The Israelites did so, putting them outside the camp; as the Lord had spoken to Moses, so the Israelites did.
text_cn: 以色列子民就如此做了，将他们送到营外；上主怎样吩咐了梅瑟，以色列子民就怎样做了。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites: When a man or a woman wrongs another, breaking faith with the Lord , that person incurs guilt
text_cn: “你训令以色列子民：不论男女，对近人作了什么不义的事，因此得罪上主而自觉有罪，

text_en: and shall confess the sin that has been committed. The person shall make full restitution for the wrong, adding one-fifth to it, and giving it to the one who was wronged.
text_cn: 他该承认自己所作的不义，除赔偿全部损失外，还应另加五分之一给他所害的人。

text_en: If the injured party has no next of kin to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for wrong shall go to the Lord for the priest, in addition to the ram of atonement with which atonement is made for the guilty party.
text_cn: 若此人没有近亲可向他赔偿，这赔偿就归上主，属于司祭。此外尚应献一赎罪的公绵羊，为自己赎罪。

text_en: Among all the sacred donations of the Israelites, every gift that they bring to the priest shall be his.
text_cn: 以色列子民在奉献的各种圣物中，凡是给司祭的献仪，即归于司祭。

text_en: The sacred donations of all are their own; whatever anyone gives to the priest shall be his.
text_cn: 每人所奉献的圣物，应归自己；但人给与司祭的，应归于司祭。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：若某人的妻子背离丈夫，

text_en: if a man has had intercourse with her but it is hidden from her husband, so that she is undetected though she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her since she was not caught in the act;
text_cn: 对他不忠，瞒着丈夫让人与她同睡交媾(gòu)，在暗中玷污了自己，又没有见证，也没有被捉住；

text_en: if a spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife who has defiled herself; or if a spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, though she has not defiled herself;
text_cn: 若丈夫心生疑忌，疑忌他的妻子受了玷污；或者心生疑忌，疑忌他的妻子，但她实在没有受玷污；

text_en: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest. And he shall bring the offering required for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it, for it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
text_cn: 丈夫就应带他的妻子到司祭前，为她献祭，献十分之一‘厄法’的大麦粉，其上不可倒油，也不可加乳香，因为这是因疑忌所献的素祭，是一回忆罪过的素祭。

text_en: Then the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord ;
text_cn: 司祭令她前来，站在上主面前；

text_en: the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
text_cn: 然后用陶器取些圣水，再由会幕地上取些尘土，放入水内。

text_en: The priest shall set the woman before the Lord , dishevel the woman’s hair, and place in her hands the grain offering of remembrance, which is the grain offering of jealousy. In his own hand the priest shall have the water of bitterness that brings the curse.
text_cn: 司祭叫这女人站在上主面前，松开她的头发，将回忆的素祭品，即为疑忌所献的素祭品，放在她的掌上，司祭手内拿着给人招致咒骂的苦水，

text_en: Then the priest shall make her take an oath, saying, “If no man has lain with you, if you have not turned aside to uncleanness while under your husband’s authority, be immune to this water of bitterness that brings the curse.
text_cn: 然后司祭命那女人起誓，对她说：‘若没有人与你同睡，若你没有背离丈夫受玷污，愿这招致咒骂的苦水于你无害。

text_en: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority, if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has had intercourse with you, ”
text_cn: 但是，如果你背离了丈夫受了玷污，让丈夫以外的男人与你同睡，──

text_en: —let the priest make the woman take the oath of the curse and say to the woman—“the Lord make you an execration and an oath among your people, when the Lord makes your uterus drop, your womb discharge;
text_cn: 在此司祭叫那女人以诅咒的誓辞起誓，然后对她说：──愿上主使你在你民族中成为可咒骂和诅咒的人，使你大腿萎缩，使你肚腹肿胀！

text_en: now may this water that brings the curse enter your bowels and make your womb discharge, your uterus drop! ” And the woman shall say, “Amen. Amen. ”
text_cn: 愿这招致咒骂的水进入你的五脏，使你肚腹肿胀，使你大腿萎缩！’女人答说：‘阿们、阿们。’

text_en: Then the priest shall put these curses in writing, and wash them off into the water of bitterness.
text_cn: 随后司祭将这些咒文写在纸上，用苦水洗去，

text_en: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings the curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter her and cause bitter pain.
text_cn: 令女人喝这招致咒骂的苦水。这招致咒骂的水一进入她内，就给她带来苦楚。

text_en: The priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall elevate the grain offering before the Lord and bring it to the altar;
text_cn: 司祭再由这女人的手内，接过为疑忌所献的素祭祭品，在上主面前行过摇礼后，放在祭坛上；

text_en: and the priest shall take a handful of the grain offering, as its memorial portion, and turn it into smoke on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
text_cn: 再由这素祭祭品内取出一把来作为纪念，放在祭坛上焚烧；以后，才令女人喝这水。

text_en: When he has made her drink the water, then, if she has defiled herself and has been unfaithful to her husband, the water that brings the curse shall enter into her and cause bitter pain, and her womb shall discharge, her uterus drop, and the woman shall become an execration among her people.
text_cn: 司祭命她喝水以后，事必灵验：如果她受了玷污，对丈夫不忠，这招致咒骂的水一进入她内，就给她带来苦楚；她的肚腹必肿胀，大腿必萎缩；这女人在她的民族中，必成为可咒骂的人。

text_en: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, then she shall be immune and be able to conceive children.
text_cn: 但是，如果这女人没有受玷污，而是贞洁的，就不致受害，反要生育子女。

text_en: This is the law in cases of jealousy, when a wife, while under her husband’s authority, goes astray and defiles herself,
text_cn: 这是关于疑忌事的法律：几时一个妇人，背离丈夫，受了玷污；

text_en: or when a spirit of jealousy comes on a man and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the Lord , and the priest shall apply this entire law to her.
text_cn: 或是一个男人心生疑忌，疑忌自己的妻子，他应带妻子站在上主面前，司祭应对她执行这法律所规定的一切。

text_en: The man shall be free from iniquity, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.
text_cn: 如此，男人可免无罪，女人应自负罪债。”
